set_aside.subject: active_flow_version
set_aside.text: active_flow_version: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise UnknownReferenceError naming the flow_id when no Flow record has it: the read is RecordsById with when_missing unknown_reference, its UnknownReferenceError propagating.
set_aside.rule: - note, которая не должна создавать ребро, не называет чужой экспорт целым словом
set_aside.question: Replace the whole-word export name Flow with wording such as “flow record” so the note does not require the now-undeclared Flow import.
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
